Edgewood explains both, offers online reservations for up to eight, and leaves prices to your team until you publish them.</p></div><button class=\"b2 ask\" type=\"button\" data-open data-q=\"How do tastings work, and do we need a reservation?\" aria-label=\"Ask Edgewood: How do tastings work, and what do they cost?\">Ask Edgewood</button></div>\n\n<div class=\"q\"><span class=\"n\">2</span><div><h3>&ldquo;We&rsquo;re getting married. Edgewood shares the <span class=\"nw\">full-day</span> rental, the Aurora tent and the inclusive package, then sends the couple&rsquo;s date and guest count to your events team.</p></div><button class=\"b2 ask\" type=\"button\" data-open data-q=\"We're getting married next fall. Edgewood says picnics are welcome, gives <span class=\"nw\">Barrel &amp; Board&rsquo;s</span> days, and suggests a quick call that day.</p></div><button class=\"b2 ask\" type=\"button\" data-open data-q=\"Is the food truck open on Saturday, and can we bring a picnic?\" aria-label=\"Ask Edgewood: Is the food truck open, and can we bring a picnic?\">Ask Edgewood</button></div>\n\n<div class=\"q\"><span class=\"n\">4</span><div><h3>&ldquo;It&rsquo;s cold out. Edgewood points guests to the Four Seasons Glass Pavilion, which closes up on cold or rainy days and opens to the vineyard when it&rsquo;s fair.</p></div><button class=\"b2 ask\" type=\"button\" data-open data-q=\"It's going to be cold this weekend.
